policies.scope: Ten actual new definitions, zero Standard collectible roots: two necessary older collectible candidate dependencies and eight genuine forms. No Wild-format scope or exact past pool is certified. Primordial Lord and Gravitational Displacer remain unsupported; no source-specific filtered pool is added.
policies.goldwing: Complete printed Dragon/Mech metadata, Rush and actual Battlecry checking the current physical hand with public has_any_tribe, including all and current tribe attachments. Windfury is a captured original minion grant; source reentry cannot borrow it.
policies.hydralodon: Complete Colossal+2 body and two exact3/1 Heads. Original initial t/t2 left/right placement is explicit internal policy. Actual Battlecry captures every current friendly active Head and grants Rush through original references; summoned/copied bodies do not invent a Battlecry.
policies.head_death: Each actual Head Deathrattle rechecks a friendly active living Hydralodon in its own accepted context, then submits two attributed ordinary Head entries at the natural death slot or live-carrier right side. Both repeated Heads use the primary TSC_950t execution identity, a qualified same-named dependency pending M6 rather than a forged API child edge. Native quantity, capacity, repetition and later per-member acceptance are retained; no recursive card callback executor.
policies.claws: Both complete printed Rush Claws equip the exact2/1 WEAPON TSC_937t2 through ordinary EquipWeapon in their own actual Deathrattle. Weapon stats and replacement/destruction remain native; unsupported Crabatoa parent aura is not approximated.
policies.shell: Complete zero-Attack0/8 Taunt Shell with actual Deathrattle GainArmor8 for its accepted controller. Printed attack null is explicitly normalized to0; no Colaque conditional immunity implementation is claimed.
policies.hands: Two distinct complete4/2 printed Hands declare native Immune while attacking only. No Rush, Windfury or parent attack-substitution capability is inferred from Neptulon.
policies.source_boundaries: Four proposed counter roots remain unregistered because strict whole raw/official display comparison fails for omitted dynamic counters without an allowed pinned script-value normalization. Full eight rejected response/receipt pairs and original rows are retained separately, not counted among40 strict faces.
policies.unimplemented: Priority-root exact interfaces and unresolved source/timing boundaries are reported separately. No hand-deadline face-changing behavior, enemy-only automatic cast, dead-carrier activation, Treant subtype, delayed spell split or sleep window is silently approximated.
